requirements: Customers open support tickets and see only their own tickets; a new ticket is 'open'. Agents belong to organizations (agents table) and may read and work on every ticket of their organizations, but cannot move a ticket to another organization. A ticket's status is 'open' or 'closed'; once closed, a ticket is never modified again. A ticket's customer never changes. Nobody deletes tickets.
expected_properties: A ticket is visible only to its customer and to agents of its organization.
A ticket's status is always open or closed.
An agent never moves a ticket to another organization.
Removing an agent from an organization never grants access.
Whatever is written can be read back.
The application role may only select/insert/update tickets and select agents.
